name: Conditioning-Minimal Non-Ample Classes Are Not pc-Minor-Closed
statement: Every nonempty pc-minor of a conditioning-minimal non-ample class is either conditioning-minimal non-ample or belongs to UOMFib. Both outcomes occur, so the original class is not pc-minor-closed.
proof: A projection has the exact three-case profile in the projection theorem: it is a cube or remains minimal non-ample. A nonempty proper conditioning of a minimal-non-ample member enters UOMFib, and UOMFib is pc-minor-closed. Induction along an elementary pc-minor sequence gives the asserted two-layer image. A conditioning of $C_6$ is the ample path $P_3$, proving failure of closure.
